admin.directory.search.description: Search the internal user directory (display name, org unit, work email) to pick owners/assignees. Never returns external users, roles or clearances.

admin.users.read.description: View user accounts: status, account type (internal/external), IdP issuer+subject binding, last sign-in.

admin.users.manage.description: Create, disable and reactivate accounts; bind IdP issuer+subject; bind an external account to exactly one counterparty.

admin.sessions.revoke.description: Revoke all active sessions of a user; effective on the next request.

admin.access.suspend.description: Emergency suspension of all role assignments and room grants of one user (content-free, reversible, audited).

admin.external_access.suspend.description: Emergency suspension of all external (partner) sign-ins and sessions organisation-wide.

admin.role_assignment.read.description: View role assignments, room grants and clearance grants within scope.

admin.role_assignment.manage.description: Assign or revoke roles at a scope, limited by the assignability table.

admin.clearance.grant.description: Raise a user's clearance for one project above the role default, with reason and expiry; never above the grantor's own clearance.

admin.org_settings.manage.description: Manage organisation technical settings (session lifetimes, OIDC client, egress allowlist entries, upload limits). Unsafe production values are refused by config validation.

admin.service_account.manage.description: Create, rotate and disable service principals (BI reader, integration identities).

portfolio.portfolio.read.description: View portfolio/program structure and the names of projects in scope.

portfolio.portfolio.manage.description: Create and edit portfolios and programs.

portfolio.project.create.description: Create a project from a published template version.

portfolio.project.read.description: View project overview, charter, parties, sites and the four independent status dimensions.

portfolio.project.update.description: Edit the project profile through commands (objective, parties, sites list).

portfolio.project.archive.description: Administratively archive a project once its handover criteria are met.

portfolio.dashboard.read.description: View portfolio/program health aggregates computed only over records the caller may read.

portfolio.cross_dependency.manage.description: Create or edit a cross-project dependency; caller must also hold planning.dependency.manage in both projects; the counterpart project sees minimum fields only.

config.template.read.description: View template versions (phases, gates, fields, forms, workflows, KPIs).

config.template.publish.description: Publish a template version (publisher must not be its author).

config.template_migration.propose.description: Preview and propose moving a project to a newer template version (AT-26).

config.template_migration.approve.description: Approve a previewed template migration for a project.

config.project_settings.manage.description: Project settings: working calendar and holidays, RAG thresholds, default classification, retention defaults, quiet hours.

governance.committee.read.description: View committees, charter versions and membership.

governance.committee.manage.description: Create committees; draft charter versions; manage membership, quorum, voting and recusal rules (draft).

governance.authority_matrix.manage.description: Draft delegation/authority matrix versions (decision types, thresholds with currency and unit).

governance.authority_matrix.approve.description: Approve and activate an authority matrix version. Until one is active, production approvals that need authority are refused.

governance.meeting.read.description: View meetings, agendas, attendance, frozen meeting packs and minutes.

governance.meeting.manage.description: Schedule meetings, build numbered agendas, record attendance, freeze meeting-pack snapshots.

governance.agenda_request.screen.description: Secretariat screening: accept, return or defer an agenda request.

governance.decision.read.description: View decision papers, states, votes and outcomes.

governance.decision.draft.description: Create and edit decision papers in Draft.

governance.decision.submit.description: Submit a decision paper (Draft to Submitted).

governance.decision.review.description: Secretariat review: Submitted to Under Review, request information, return.

governance.conflict.declare.description: Declare a conflict of interest or recusal for an agenda item or decision.

governance.decision.vote.description: Cast a vote. The server also requires active voting membership, quorum present and no recusal.

governance.decision.record_outcome.description: Record the outcome from the server-computed tally. Outside the committee's delegation only Recommended / Pending external authority is accepted (AT-04).

governance.decision.record_external_appr.description: Record a higher authority's decision together with its evidence.

governance.decision.verify_implementatio.description: Mark a decision Implemented-Verified after checking closure evidence.

governance.action.manage.description: Create, assign and re-date committee actions.

governance.action.update.description: Update progress and evidence on actions the actor owns or is assigned.

governance.action.verify_closure.description: Verify closure of a committee action.

governance.escalation.raise.description: Raise an escalation (requested action, decision deadline, options).

planning.plan.read.description: View WBS, tasks, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, baselines, RAID, change requests and periodic updates.

planning.wbs.manage.description: Create and edit WBS elements, milestones and deliverables (non-baselined fields).

planning.task.manage.description: Create and edit tasks and RACI entries. Changing an existing accountable owner needs planning.ownership.reassign.

planning.ownership.reassign.description: Change the accountable owner of an existing task, milestone, deliverable, risk or action.

planning.task.update_progress.description: Update status, progress and actuals on tasks the actor owns or is assigned.

planning.dependency.manage.description: Create and edit dependencies (cycle-checked on the server).

planning.change_request.assess.description: Record the impact assessment of a change request (time, cost, scope, readiness, transaction).

planning.change_request.approve.description: Approve or reject a change request.

planning.raid.manage.description: Create and edit risks, assumptions, issues and dependency entries.

planning.rag_override.set.description: Set a manual RAG override with reason and expiry (calculated value retained).

planning.status_update.review.description: Review, accept or return a periodic update.

gates.gate.read.description: View gate definitions, criteria, evidence status, assessments, waivers and decisions.

gates.definition.manage.description: Draft project gate definitions, criteria and prerequisites.

gates.definition.approve.description: Approve changes to a project's gate definitions.

gates.criterion.set_waivability.description: Specialist determination of a criterion's waivability and waiver authority.

gates.evidence.attach.description: Attach evidence to gate criteria (evidence stays unverified until reviewed).

gates.assessment.decide.description: Record a gate decision. The server re-evaluates mandatory criteria, evidence and approvals; task completion alone never unlocks a gate.

gates.assessment.reopen.description: Reopen an assessment through the controlled process when relied-upon evidence is defective (AT-14); prior decisions are preserved.

gates.waiver.request.description: Request a waiver with basis and impact.

gates.waiver.approve.description: Approve a waiver. Non-waivable criteria are refused regardless of role (AT-13).

carveout.register.read.description: View perimeter, sites, transfers, agreements, consents and reconciliation.

carveout.perimeter.manage.description: Create and edit perimeter items and sites (post-baseline changes go through change control).

carveout.transfer.manage.description: Maintain transfer records and their evidence links.

carveout.agreement.manage.description: Maintain agreement register entries (parties, scope, versions, negotiation stage, obligations).

carveout.consent.manage.description: Maintain consents, novations and assignments tracking.

carveout.contract.classify.description: Specialist transferability classification (transferable / consent / novation / retain / interim / unknown).

newco.register.read.description: View legal entities, incorporation status and the regulatory requirement/approval registers.

newco.incorporation.manage.description: Record incorporation steps and proposed status with evidence.

newco.regulatory.manage.description: Maintain regulatory requirements and approval register entries (draft).

newco.regulatory.verify.description: Record a specialist applicability assessment or a verified approval with validity.

readiness.register.read.description: View readiness checks, cutover plans, go/no-go history and the TSA register.

readiness.check.manage.description: Maintain site/workstream readiness checks and blockers.

readiness.check.signoff.description: Specialist sign-off of a readiness check.

readiness.cutover.manage.description: Maintain cutover plans, runbooks, windows and contingency.

readiness.go_no_go.decide.description: Record a go/no-go decision; blockers are re-evaluated on the server (AT-09).

readiness.tsa.manage.description: Maintain TSA services, SLAs, exit milestones and replacement services.

readiness.tsa.approve_exit.description: Approve a TSA exit (approveTSAExit); end date alone never means exit (AT-10).

finance.record.read.description: View financial snapshots, budget lines, commitments, costs, benefits and KPI observations.

finance.budget.manage.description: Edit budget lines, commitments and actuals (approved budget changes go through change control).

finance.snapshot.approve.description: Human financial validation of statements, balances and financial snapshots.

finance.model.manage.description: Import and version business-plan/valuation model outputs and assumptions.

finance.benefit.verify.description: Verify a benefit realisation against its verification source.

finance.kpi.manage.description: Define KPIs (definition, formula, unit, owner, thresholds) and record observations.

jv.partner.read.description: View partner longlist/shortlist, criteria, stages and conflict disclosures.

jv.partner.manage.description: Maintain partner longlist/shortlist, criteria, weights and conflict disclosures.

jv.partner.approve_contact.description: Approve a partner for contact (outreach approval).

jv.partner.advance_stage.description: Record an engagement stage transition with evidence; server enforces stage order (NDA does not imply materials access).

jv.nda.record.description: Record NDA execution and its evidence.

jv.deal.read.description: View partner proposals, ownership/governance scenarios, negotiation issues and comparative assessments.

jv.proposal.manage.description: Maintain partner proposals and comparative assessments (facts separated from team judgement).

jv.scenario.manage.description: Maintain versioned ownership, capital-contribution and governance scenarios.

jv.room.read.description: Open a partner/internal/clean-team room and view its index. Every access is audited.

jv.room.manage.description: Create a room (partner / internal / clean_team), manage its index and folders, set its AI-indexing flag.

jv.room.grant_access.description: Grant a user access to a room (level, expiry, basis). Partner must be at Materials-access stage; grants into clean-team rooms need a clean-team grantee.

jv.room.lock.description: Lock a room: suspend all grants and downloads immediately (containment).

jv.dd_request.create.description: Create a due-diligence request/question in a room.

jv.dd_request.read.description: View DD requests, internal drafts, assignees and review state (internal projection).

jv.dd_request.read_external.description: View own room's DD requests in the external projection only (question, status, due date).

jv.dd_request.assign.description: Assign a DD request to an internal owner.

jv.dd_answer.draft.description: Draft an answer to an assigned DD request.

jv.disclosure.release.description: Approve release of a specific DD answer or document version into a partner room (creates the disclosure record).

jv.disclosure.revoke.description: Withdraw a disclosed item from a room (cannot recall copies already downloaded).

jv.disclosure.view.description: View items disclosed into the actor's own room, disclosed version only. Audited.

jv.disclosure.download.description: Download a disclosed document version from the actor's own room. Audited; watermarked where supported.

jv.disclosure_log.read.description: View a room's disclosure and access history.

jv.submission.upload.description: Upload a partner submission into the actor's own room; enters quarantine and scanning.

jv.finding.manage.description: Maintain DD findings (materiality, risks, remediation, valuation/document/CP implications).

jv.clean_team_output.submit.description: Submit a clean-team output (aggregated/redacted) for release review.

jv.clean_team_output.release.description: Release a reviewed clean-team output to the wider deal team (clears the clean-team flag on that output only).

jv.closing_checklist.manage.description: Maintain signing and closing checklists, closing deliverables, conditions subsequent and post-close obligations.

jv.cp.manage.description: Maintain closing conditions (reference, owner, evidence links, long-stop date).

jv.cp.verify.description: Verify a closing condition (verifyCP) against evidence.

jv.cp.waive.description: Waive a closing condition. Non-waivable conditions are refused (AT-12, AT-13).

jv.signing.record.description: Record signing of a transaction agreement with the executed copy.

jv.closing.declare.description: Authorised closing confirmation. Refused while any mandatory CP is unverified and unwaived (AT-12).

jv.funds_flow.manage.description: Track closing funds flows (the platform never executes payments).

documents.document.read.description: List, search and view document metadata/preview. Titles, snippets and counts only for documents the caller may read.

documents.document.download.description: Download a document version through the authorised streaming endpoint. Audited.

documents.document.upload.description: Upload a document or new version (enters quarantine/scan). Classification cannot exceed the uploader's clearance.

documents.document.classify.description: Set or raise a document's classification and domain tag.

documents.document.archive.description: Withdraw (soft-delete) a non-evidence document; refused under legal hold or when linked as evidence.

documents.evidence.link.description: Link a document version as evidence to a record; also requires the update permission on the target record.

documents.source.manage.description: Maintain the source register, extraction results and source claims (claims enter as proposed/unknown).

documents.claim.verify.description: Set a source claim's verification status (confirmed / conflicting).

documents.legal_hold.manage.description: Place or release a legal hold; set retention class.

documents.document.dispose.description: Authorised disposal after retention expiry; refused under legal hold (AT-27).

reports.report.generate.description: Generate a report/export from live data in scope; output classification is the maximum of its inputs.

reports.snapshot.read.description: View a report snapshot; permission is re-checked on every access.

reports.snapshot.export.description: Download a snapshot as XLSX/PDF/PPTX/DOCX (formula-injection neutralised). Audited.

reports.bi_view.read.description: Read BI views (service principal only; security-invoker views).

imports.batch.read.description: View import batches, mapping, validation results and history.

imports.batch.create.description: Upload an Excel/CSV file, map, validate and preview (values only, formulas never evaluated).

imports.batch.approve.description: Approve merging a validated batch; approved records outside change control cannot be overwritten.

imports.batch.rollback.description: Roll back an import batch where feasible.

imports.quarantine.release.description: Release a quarantined file after security review (content-free decision).

integrations.connection.read.description: View connectors, their honest status (Not configured / Disabled / Validated) and execution logs.

integrations.connection.manage.description: Configure connectors (endpoint, OAuth scopes, destinations), validate connectivity, rotate connector secrets.

integrations.send_authority.approve.description: Approve a project's outbound sending authority and destination list for a write/send connector.

notifications.inbox.read.description: Read own notifications; content is re-authorised at render time.

notifications.policy.manage.description: Manage project notification policy, quiet hours and digests.

notifications.message.send.description: Send a message via an enabled adapter to approved internal destinations; each recipient is re-authorised for the content at send time.

ai.assistant.use.description: Ask questions and request drafts/briefings; retrieval is limited to the caller's ACL inside SQL.

ai.proposal.read.description: View AI proposals, rationale, evidence snapshot and diff.

ai.proposal.approve.description: Approve an AI proposal. Approval binds payload hash, target version, approver and expiry; the approver must independently pass the underlying action's permission and conditions.

ai.settings.manage.description: Set a project's AI mode (off / advisory / assisted), budgets, schedules and room-indexing flags.

ai.autopilot_policy.approve.description: Approve a policy-limited autopilot allowlist (actions, limits, scope, rate, expiry).

ai.provider.configure.description: Configure organisation provider adapters, the policy-gateway endpoint, approved destinations, classification ceilings and DLP rules.

ai.killswitch.activate.description: Activate the AI emergency stop (organisation or project): blocks new/pending actions, cancels unsent messages.

ai.killswitch.release.description: Release the AI emergency stop (releaser must not be the activator).

ai.run.read.description: View AI runs: prompts/outputs redacted to the viewer's clearance, tool calls, citations, costs.

ai.operations.read.description: View content-free AI health, cost, latency and error metrics.

ai.evaluation.run.description: Run evaluation suites on synthetic datasets only.

audit.event.read.description: Read audit events in scope; payload fields above the reader's clearance are redacted.

audit.security_event.read.description: Read authentication, session, permission and administration events (content-free).

audit.event.export.description: Export an audit extract with hash-chain proof. Audited.

audit.chain.verify.description: Run hash-chain verification against the external anchor.

ai_runtime.description: Worker identity for the runtime AI PM. Holds no role assignments. Effective permissions per call = permissions with ai in {retrieve, propose} INTERSECT the delegating user's permissions evaluated at execution time INTERSECT the project's AI-mode allowlist. 'propose' permissions execute only after a bound human approval (assisted) or under an approved autopilot policy.

bi_reader.description: Restricted service account for BI-ready views. Explicit project list, maxClearance internal unless raised through admin.clearance.grant; never room or clean-team data.

integration_adapter.description: Per-connector identity used only to authenticate to the external system. Holds no content permissions; sends execute notifications.message.send under the approving/sending user's authority, re-checked at send time.
